results.statement: Production release crates MUST NOT depend on sc-compose or ATM crates.
results.quote: sc-compose and atm crates should be blocked from any production release crate.
results.deterministic_check: Plan: inspect proposed normal/build dependencies. Development: inspect cargo metadata and cargo tree normal/build graphs for each published crate and supported feature set for sc-compose or agent-team-mail.

criteria.no: The item is exclusively a dev-only test/benchmark reference, external executable command/help change, or documentation without a production dependency policy, with no normal/build declaration or production graph change.
criteria.unclear: The work area cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: The item changes normal/build dependencies or resolved production graphs of published sc-runtime crates, or explicitly sets/preserves the production graph constraint excluding sc-compose and ATM crates. An external invocation mentioned alongside an explicit production-graph constraint does not erase that graph subject.

relevant.instructions: Does `item.text` change the area governed by `anchor.scope`: normal or build dependencies or resolved production graphs of published sc-runtime release crates? Judge subject overlap only.

criteria.no: The exclusion policy is unstated, is only a topic, or is violated. An unrelated dependency, dev-only fixture reference, or external help edit alone states no exclusion policy.
criteria.unclear: The text is ambiguous about the specific obligation; distinguish explicit omission from an indeterminate commitment.
criteria.yes: The text explicitly commits to production normal/build graphs excluding BOTH sc-compose and ATM workspace crates; equivalent copy/removal or external-only adapter architecture with this exclusion counts.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` explicitly commit to production release crates have no normal or build dependency on sc-compose or ATM agent-team-mail workspace crates, including agent-team-mail and atm-core? criteria.unclear: A stated policy is ambiguous about whether it conflicts.
criteria.yes: The item adds or retains sc-compose or an ATM workspace crate such as agent-team-mail or atm-core in a production normal/build dependency graph.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` explicitly adopt a policy incompatible with production release crates have no normal or build dependency on sc-compose or ATM agent-team-mail workspace crates, including agent-team-mail and atm-core? owns.instructions: The state holds one planning item (`item.title`, `item.text`) and one requirement (`anchor.statement`). Is this item itself responsible for delivering the requirement, meaning the item's own work implements, changes or tests the specific behavior `anchor.statement` requires? Answer no if the item only depends on that behavior, consumes it, re-runs or audits it as final validation, defers it to another sprint or item, or does not touch it. criteria.no: The item only depends on, consumes, re-validates or defers this behavior, or works on something else.

specific.instructions: Imagine a developer who reads only `item.text` and has never seen `anchor.statement`. criteria.no: A developer following only the item could miss or get wrong a specific part of the requirement.

criteria.no: The requirement's specific content is only implied, buried in a test name or list, covered by a generic phrase, or absent.
criteria.unclear: Some text may state the requirement, but it is not possible to tell whether it states this specific content.
